reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Constrains LLM-assisted coding by surfacing ambiguity before implementation, rejecting speculative abstractions, tracing every changed line to the request, cleaning only newly orphaned code, and turning work into explicit verification loops.
neutralIntentExamples: keep a bug fix limited to the failing behavior and its regression test
simplify an overbuilt change without refactoring unrelated neighboring code
inputs: a coding, review, or refactoring request
explicit assumptions, unresolved interpretations, and project-local style
changed-code scope plus tests or other observable success criteria
operations: state uncertain assumptions and competing interpretations before selecting an implementation
remove unrequested flexibility and single-use abstractions while matching the existing code style
audit each changed line against the request, delete only orphans introduced by the change, and repeat the named verification until it passes
outputs: surgical code diff with no unrelated cleanup
task-specific success criteria and fresh verification result
failureBehavior: material ambiguity pauses implementation for clarification instead of being resolved silently
an overlong or speculative solution is reduced to the minimum requested behavior
failed verification keeps the task open and drives another bounded correction
exclusions: does not delete pre-existing dead code, reformat adjacent files, or refactor unrelated components
does not replace repository architecture, style rules, or domain-specific verification
trivial tasks may use a lighter version of the planning controls
usefulInvariants: every modified line traces to the user's request or to an orphan created by that modification
success is expressed as an observable check rather than make-it-work language
project-local style wins over the reviewer's preferred style
materialRisks: a rigid minimum-diff bias can preserve a flawed local abstraction when broader change is actually required
the two-hundred-versus-fifty-line heuristic is illustrative rather than a reliable complexity measure
excessive clarification can slow low-risk work if the caution tradeoff is not scaled
